description: Approved StudioFlow source identity and generated assets for the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-134 scene drag-and-drop and production-item color restoration. The staging workflow builds exactly this clean source commit and compares its output against these hashes. The release keeps the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-133 floating Studio actions menu correction and the guarded typed-name deletion flow, and restores the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-125 teleprompter-script production items with the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-126A orange/purple/blue/yellow/green production-item color system on the released lineage.
